description.zh:
文档库名称。

> 由[CreateDocumentCollection](~~2618448~~)接口创建。您可以调用[ListDocumentCollections](~~2618452~~)接口查看已经创建的文档库。
description.en:
The name of the document collection.

> You create this document collection by calling the [CreateDocumentCollection](~~2618448~~) operation. To view existing document collections, call the [ListDocumentCollections](~~2618452~~) operation.

description.zh:
实例ID。

> 您可以调用[DescribeDBInstances](~~86911~~)接口查看目标地域下所有的AnalyticDB PostgreSQL实例的详情，包括实例ID。
description.en:
The instance ID.

> Call the [DescribeDBInstances](~~86911~~) operation to view details for all AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instances in a specific region, including their instance IDs.

description.zh:
命名空间，默认为public。

> 您可以通过[ListNamespaces](~~2401502~~)接口查看列表。
description.en:
The name of the namespace. The default value is public.

> Call the [ListNamespaces](~~2401502~~) operation to view a list of namespaces.

description.zh:
命名空间对应的密码。

> 本值为[CreateNamespace](~~2401495~~)接口指定。
description.en:
The password for the namespace.

> This password is set when you call the [CreateNamespace](~~2401495~~) operation.
The region ID of the instance.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun gpdb delete-chunks --db-instance-id gp-xxxxxxxxx --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --namespace mynamespace --namespace-password testpassword --collection testcollection --chunk-ids doc_1234 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun gpdb DeleteChunks --region cn-hangzhou --DBInstanceId 'gp-xxxxxxxxx' --ChunkIds doc_1234 --Collection testcollection --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --NamespacePassword testpassword --Namespace mynamespace
